name: Eyebite
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Roll Spirit vs Spirit against a creature within medium range. On a win, choose one effect:

  • Asleep. The creature falls unconscious. It wakes up if it takes any damage or if another creature spends an action to shake the sleeper awake.

  • Panicked. The creature is frightened of you. On each of its turns, it must move away from you until it is outside long range from you.

  • Sickened. The creature becomes temporarily Weary, Miserable or Helpless - your choice.

On a loss, no effect, and you cannot target that creature again with this casting of this spell.

Each Round, you may spend an action to target one additional creature within medium range.
